/bin/zsh -lc 'env -u goroot gocache="$pwd/.scratch/go/cache" gotmpdir="$pwd/.scratch/go/tmp" goproxy=off go test -mod=readonly ./...'

/bin/zsh -lc 'go version
 go env goroot gotooldir gotoolchain goenv
printenv goroot gotooldir gotoolchain goenv
rg --files --hidden .scratch'

/bin/zsh -lc 'gofmt -w audit/normalize.go audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go

/bin/zsh -lc 'shasum go.mod audit/*_test.go service/*_test.go metrics/*_test.go legacy/*_test.go
